remaining_concerns: 03-system.tex: the paragraph beginning 'The Trial Review application aligns gaze and controller state...' sits under 'Voice Preparation and Audio' but discusses data alignment and gaze sampling. The section hierarchy is protected, so it was not moved; the author may want to move it to the Trial Review Interface subsection.

The phrase 'when speech is admitted' (03-system Sensing; 05-measurement Gaze Contact) is internal scheduler shorthand. Its exact meaning could not be confirmed from the source, so it was left; the author should gloss it once (for example, 'when the scheduler permits speech').

03-measures-scoring.tex repeats much of 05-measurement.tex: instruction-count categories, timing distinctions, head-motion accumulation and gaze-contact definitions. This may be intentional, but the scoring section could point back to Data Collection instead of restating it.

Input order puts 05-measurement (Data Collection) before 03-measures-scoring (Measures and Scoring), despite the file prefixes. Cross-references currently resolve correctly, but the file naming may confuse later editing.

The Objects subsection still mixes the present-tense layout description with future-tense pending checks (stimulus density, passthrough settings). This split is deliberate and was preserved; the reference to passthrough settings next to the stated virtual-reality configuration may need author clarification.
04-method uses 'below' and 'defined in the same table' cross-references in places. A final check of reference targets after compilation is advisable.
